title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes | TechCrunch
summary: The first models in the Sol and Luna series were introduced earlier this year , representing different tiers in OpenAI’s hierarchy of models. OpenAI expects to roll out the models to ChatGPT (the app and website) gradually throughout the day.
